```php
<?php

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use App\Models\TodoItem;

class TodoItemSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run()
    {
        // Define the number of items to seed
        $itemCount = 10;

        for ($i = 1; $i <= $itemCount; $i++) {
            // Generate a random title and description
            $title = "Item {$i}";
            $description = "Description for item {$i}";

            // Create the TodoItem using the factory
            TodoItem::create([
                'title' => $title,
                'description' => $description,
            ]);
        }
    }
}
```
